data.body: **P2:** The synthetic root is created only after its Invocation and Workflow descendants have started, so those spans still parent onto the placeholder context rather than the exported root's resolved sampling metadata. Parent-dependent trace-state updates are computed from an empty state, and deferred `RECORD_ONLY` decisions leave descendant parent flags inconsistent with the actual root. Start the synthetic root before creating descendants, use its resulting `SpanContext` as `executionAncestor`, and end/re-export it at invocation end. Add assertions for child parent trace state and flags under a parent-dependent sampler.
